issuer: the Maine Secretary of State, Bureau of Motor Vehicles
note: The Maine Revised Statutes, Title 29-A, on legislature.maine.gov (read 2026-10-30): § 1406-A has a noncommercial licence issued under 65 expire on the sixth birthday after issue and charges $30 for it ($55 under § 1260, REAL ID); § 1304 issues a learner's permit from 15 and lets someone under 21 apply for a licence only 6 months after it, and § 1311 restricts a licence issued under 18 for 270 days, so a full licence is kept from 17 (about 16¼ rounded up). § 1410 issues a nondriver identification card for $5, expiring on the sixth birthday after issue; no age is held for it. The Bureau's fee page refused the request (403). On 2026-10-30 the licence was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from § 1406-A: 6 years at $30 under 65 and 4 years at $20 from 65; until then it held the 6-year licence only.

sources.title: 29-A M.R.S. § 1406-A, Expiration
sources.said: a noncommercial driver's license to operate a motor vehicle issued to a person under 65 years of age expires at midnight on the license holder's 6th birthday following the date of issuance. ... The fee for the 6-year noncommercial driver's license is $30. ... A noncommercial or commercial driver's license to operate a motor vehicle issued to a person 65 years of age or older at the date of issuance expires at midnight on the license holder's 4th birthday following the date of issuance. ... The fee for the 4-year noncommercial driver's license is $20.

sources.title: 29-A M.R.S. § 1304, Learner's permits
sources.said: A person who is 15 years of age or older may apply for a learner's permit ... A person under 21 years of age may not apply for a license unless: (1) A period of 6 months has passed from the date the person was issued a learner's permit;

sources.title: 29-A M.R.S. § 1311, Intermediate license
sources.said: A person under 18 years of age who has been issued a driver's license may not: ... the license restrictions in subsection 1 are in effect for a period of 270 days from license issuance.

sources.title: 29-A M.R.S. § 1410, Nondriver identification cards
sources.said: fee of $5, the Secretary of State shall issue a nondriver identification card to the applicant. ... Each nondriver identification card issued pursuant to this section expires at midnight on the nondriver identification card holder's 6th birthday following the date of issuance.
